description:
The Omega Effect Part 1

▸ Years ago, Reed Richards created the "Omega Drive". This hard drive contained critical information on the world's biggest crime organizations - Hydra, AIM, Black Spectre, Secret Empire, and Hidden Team. The Omega Effect story starts with Matt Murdock's possession of the drive in Mark Waid's Daredevil series in 2012. These organizations are willing to go to the ends of the earth to stop anyone from get the drive, but Frank Castle also wants it - for his own reasons.
